guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: 访问 o1.exchange
guide.description: 进入 o1.exchange 平台，点击首页“进入 App”。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Go to the o1.exchange platform and click “Enter App” on the homepage.

guide.title: 创建你的账户
guide.description: 使用你的邮箱注册或连接 Solana 钱包。在继续之前完成所有配置文件设置步骤。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Sign up using your email or connect a Solana wallet. Complete any profile setup steps before moving on.

guide.title: 使用 SOL 为你的钱包充值
guide.description: 你需要 SOL 才能在平台上进行交易。从 Binance 购买 SOL 并将其转移到你的 Solana 钱包，或使用下面的跨链组件跨链其他网络的资产。跨链基金无需离开此页面即可在 30 多个链之间进行交换和跨链。路线快，费用低。立即跨链打开交互式桥组件在新标签页中打开跨链页面
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: You need SOL to trade on the platform. Buy SOL from Binance and transfer it to your Solana wallet, or bridge assets from another network using the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

guide.title: 跨多个代币铸造厂进行交易
guide.description: 分配公式奖励的是多样性，而不仅仅是数量。在 DEX 上交易不同的代币对，而不是循环使用同一对代币。持有期限和在平台上的保留也被考虑在内，所以不要只是流失交易并离开。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: The allocation formula rewards variety, not just volume. Trade different token pairs across the DEX rather than cycling through the same pair. Holding periods and retention on the platform are also factored in, so don’t just churn trades and leave.

guide.title: 进入奖励页面
guide.description: 在平台菜单中找到奖励或推荐部分。获取你独特的邀请链接并从此处跟踪你的 S1.1 和 S1.2 积分。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Find the rewards or referral section in the platform menu. Grab your unique referral link and track your S1.1 and S1.2 points from here.

guide.title: 推荐活跃交易者
guide.description: 与实际使用该平台的人分享你的邀请链接。该公式奖励推荐数量，因此持续交易的优质推荐对你的分配贡献比休眠注册更多。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Share your referral link with people who will actually use the platform. The formula rewards referral count, so quality referrals who trade consistently contribute more to your allocation than dormant signups.

guide.title: 参与 X 和 Discord
guide.description: 社会捐款计入你的 $O 分配。参与 o1.exchange 的 Discord，在符合条件的情况下追求 Discord Maxi 角色，并参与 X 上的项目。这些信号是公式的一部分，而不是奖金。
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。
guide.original_description: Social contributions count toward your $O allocation. Participate in o1.exchange’s Discord, pursue the Discord Maxi role if eligible, and engage with the project on X. These signals are part of the formula, not a bonus.

faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

sourcedSteps.title: Visit o1.exchange
sourcedSteps.body: Go to the o1.exchange platform and click “Enter App” on the homepage.

sourcedSteps.title: Create Your Account
sourcedSteps.body: Sign up using your email or connect a Solana wallet. Complete any profile setup steps before moving on.

sourcedSteps.title: Fund Your Wallet with SOL
sourcedSteps.body: You need SOL to trade on the platform. Buy SOL from Binance and transfer it to your Solana wallet, or bridge assets from another network using the bridge widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

sourcedSteps.title: Trade Across Multiple Token Mints
sourcedSteps.body: The allocation formula rewards variety, not just volume. Trade different token pairs across the DEX rather than cycling through the same pair. Holding periods and retention on the platform are also factored in, so don’t just churn trades and leave.

sourcedSteps.title: Access the Rewards Section
sourcedSteps.body: Find the rewards or referral section in the platform menu. Grab your unique referral link and track your S1.1 and S1.2 points from here.

sourcedSteps.title: Refer Active Traders
sourcedSteps.body: Share your referral link with people who will actually use the platform. The formula rewards referral count, so quality referrals who trade consistently contribute more to your allocation than dormant signups.

sourcedSteps.title: Engage on X and Discord
sourcedSteps.body: Social contributions count toward your $O allocation. Participate in o1.exchange’s Discord, pursue the Discord Maxi role if eligible, and engage with the project on X. These signals are part of the formula, not a bonus.
